Goal `tools-php-differences`: 3 of the chapter's 12 features are done: `arrays-and-strings`, `classes` and `closures-and-callables`. `bun nv proofs --owed --group tools:php-differences` lists the 9 still owed.
The proofs corrected five rows of `docs/reference/tools/30-php-differences.md`. § *Classes*: a leading `_` is `E0112` on a property, and the `case` keyword is `E0239`. § *Closures and callables*: `fn($x) => $x` is `E0808`, `call_user_func` is `E0320`, and `A::f(...)` and `$o->m(...)` run.
`tests/conformance/reject/a-php-closure-a-use-clause-and-an-untyped-parameter-are-refused.nvst` now pins `E0222`, `E0223` and `E0808`, which no case pinned before.
Each feature here owes one example, one attack and one case carrying `// covers:`. It owes no `about.md` or bench. `the-short-list` and `the-tools-you-do-not-install` also owe help: their sections show no code block.
Gap `nvs-runtime/a-loop-that-only-concatenates-never-stops` still marks the arrays-and-strings attack.
